results.description:
Don't miss the festive and romantic new novel from Sunday Times bestselling author Cathy Bramley - available now!

'No-one gives you the joy and magic of a second-chance romance like Cathy' MILLY JOHNSON

'A gorgeous hug of a book with all the festive feels anyone could ever want' PHILLIPA ASHLEY

'Tis the season for second chances...

When Lucy, Jack and Dylan meet on a beach in Devon, a friendship begins that will last a lifetime.

Over the next twenty years, Dylan rises to stardom and becomes a famous popstar, whilst Jack and Lucy take over the family farm and have a son, Sam - but then an accident changes everything.

And so, even with Christmas fast approaching, Lucy is feeling far from festive. Running Merrydown Farm singlehandedly was never in the plan, and she's exhausted.

On the other side of the world, Dylan is burned out and in need of a break - so when an invitation to spend Christmas with Lucy arrives, it seems like the perfect escape.

There's just one problem. It turns out Lucy didn't invite him...
